description: Save custom governance rules to the local rules file (~/.prompt-control-plane/custom-rules.json). Validates all rules against the product schema, writes to disk, and returns the rule-set hash. Rules take effect on the next optimization. Works with any LLM connected to PCP. Enterprise tier only.

rules.description: Array of custom governance rules (1-25). Build these in the Enterprise Console or craft by hand.

applies_to.description: Which prompt types this rule applies to

id.description: Snake_case rule ID — must start with lowercase letter (a-z), then a-z0-9_ chars

negative_pattern.description: Regex — if prompt matches this, rule does NOT fire

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against prompt text (required)

risk_dimension.description: Which risk dimension this rule affects

risk_weight.description: How much this rule contributes to risk score (1-25)

severity.description: BLOCKING rules can gate optimization in enforce mode

name: save_custom_rules
